apoptosis.male: Lower/ later caspase-3 and less caspase-8 nuclear import after ischemia (Liu 2009; Sharma 2011).
apoptosis.female: Higher/earlier caspase-3, predominant caspase-8 nuclear import; Q-VD-OPh protects females only (Liu 2009; Stroke 2011).
apoptosis.vulnerable: Neurons: XX > XY caspase death (HI/MCAO); CA1 most vulnerable.
apoptosis.detection: Cleaved caspase-3 IHC, TUNEL, MAP2 loss; MTT respiration (31% XY vs 51% XX at 24h starvation).

parthanatos.male: PAR formation + nuclear AIF kill males; PARP-1 deletion, nNOS blockade, PJ-34 protect males only (McCullough 2005; Yuan 2009; Du 2004).
parthanatos.female: PARP-1 protective — loss shunts to cytochrome-c/caspase, rescued by Q-VD-OPh; estradiol protection requires PARP-1 (Stroke 2011).
parthanatos.vulnerable: Cortical neurons/astrocytes (stroke/MCAO); deep gray + white matter in males (piglet HI).
parthanatos.detection: PAR polymer IHC/Western, nuclear AIF; ~50-kb fragments (PFGE).

necrosis.male: More necrotic neurons after neonatal HI (piglet global HI, males higher necrosis p<0.0001; Alonso-Alconada 2025).
necrosis.female: Less necrosis than males in same HI model; necrosis still the dominant morphology in both sexes.

ferroptosis.male: Neurons highly vulnerable (PUFA-rich, high iron); no neuron-specific sex split established.

autophagy.male: Neuronal Atg7 deletion reduces HI tissue loss (~42% vs WT); starvation kills XY neurons more (MTT ~31% vs ~51% of control; Du 2009).
autophagy.female: XX neurons resist starvation via lipid droplets; Atg7 knockdown blocks starvation death in neurons (Du 2009).

pyroptosis.male: Neuronal NLRP3 upregulated after MCAO with higher apoptosis (Franke et al.); male/female split not directly quantified.
pyroptosis.female: E2/ERβ restrains hippocampal NLRP3→IL-1β after global ischemia; OVX activates, E2 reverses (Thakkar 2016; Xu 2016).

panoptosis.male: No neuron-specific sex data; PANoptosome would bypass single-arm choice.

eryptosis.male: n/a — anucleate RBC program, not applicable to neurons.
eryptosis.female: n/a — anucleate RBC program, not applicable to neurons.

netosis.male: n/a — neutrophil-only program, not applicable to neurons.
netosis.female: n/a — neutrophil-only program, not applicable to neurons.

apoptosis.male: Male-derived BMDMs lower baseline TNF-α/IL-1β induction; testosterone impairs IL-1β output without changing M1 polarization (IJMS 2024).
apoptosis.female: Female-derived BMDMs more stimulus-sensitive (higher TNF-α/IL-1β and Fizz1/Ym1); E2 dampens IL-1β and favors anti-inflammatory shift (IJMS 2024).
apoptosis.detection: Cleaved caspase-3/IL-1β qPCR + bead immunoassay; polarization markers (iNOS/TNF vs Arg1/Fizz1/Ym1).

parthanatos.female: No macrophage-specific PARP-1/AIF sex split established.

necrosis.male: No macrophage-specific accidental-necrosis sex split established.
necrosis.female: No macrophage-specific accidental-necrosis sex split established.

necroptosis.female: No sex-split data established for macrophage necroptosis.

ferroptosis.female: No macrophage-specific ferroptosis sex split established.

autophagy.male: E2 promotes trained-immunity M1 polarization via RelB suppression; OVX/males show weaker trained response (Front Immunol 2020).
autophagy.female: Females mount stronger β-glucan trained immunity with more splenic M1 macrophages; E2 drives the effect (Front Immunol 2020).

pyroptosis.male: Lower ERβ tone → more NLRP3 assembly, Casp1 p10/GSDMD-N, IL-1β/IL-18 and LDH release; males more sepsis-prone (JCI 2026; Metabolism 2024).
pyroptosis.female: E2/ERβ restrains NLRP3→IL-1β (lung/brain OVX models; Liu 2019; Thakkar 2016; Xu 2016); ERβ loss drives macrophage pyroptosis and worse bacterial clearance (JCI 2026).
pyroptosis.vulnerable: Macrophages/microglia — canonical executors (BMDM, alveolar, colonic, peritoneal).
pyroptosis.detection: Casp1 p10, GSDMD-N, ASC specks, IL-1β/IL-18 + LDH; VX-765 rescue test.

panoptosis.male: Macrophages are the canonical PANoptosis executors in severe infection, but no sex split established.
panoptosis.female: No sex split established for macrophage PANoptosis.

eryptosis.female: n/a — anucleate RBC program, not applicable to macrophages.

netosis.male: Macrophages do not execute NETosis; NET histones/DNA license macrophage NLRP3 (crosstalk, no sex split).
netosis.female: Same — responder, not executor; no sex split established.

apoptosis.female: XX fibroblasts resist starvation better (same direction as neurons); female cells generally more oxidative-stress resistant (Tower 2020).
apoptosis.vulnerable: Fibroblasts: XY > XX PI+ death at 24h starvation (Du 2009).
apoptosis.detection: PI labeling ± 3-MA/Atg7 siRNA (starvation); p38 phosphorylation for rotenone apoptosis.
